bit: It's Friday and I treated the weekend like a second open mic. Twenty-seven packs. The Monday autopsy is still warm. I brought a new toilet joke to a door that has been locked since the sign-up sheet.

trailerGuy.punch: Friday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
tags: Weekend energy, same week, same toilets.
trailerGuy.button: Sacramento has a Friday. The mic doesn't double the autopsy because you can smell Saturday.
trailerGuy.verdict: Died as a weekend. Make Friday the comic who counted the missing nights and ignored the lock.
fixedVersions: Friday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
The weekend is close. The week did not blink.
New day. Same week. I still haven't bombed in public.
